description: The engine ABI engine-ddi builds against. tools/build/build-engine-ddi.ps1 refuses a header whose SHA-256 differs, and an engine DLL that is not the one its -Flavour pins. The release and the lab flavour (BD-167) are two builds of one source line, so each pins its own DLL; tools/build/engine_abi.py selects one, with the semantics of tools/release/release_flavour.py.
header_revision: r5-draft with optional view-instancing contract revision 1

release.engine_dll_recipe: tester.32 unsigned build artifact; raw SHA-256 verified against scratch/build-train/tester.32-r4/artifacts/release/engine12-x64-rel/record/recipe.json. Pin precedes signing; engine_abi.py does not normalize PE signatures.

lab.engine_dll_recipe: tester.32 unsigned build artifact; raw SHA-256 verified against scratch/build-train/tester.32-r4/artifacts/lab/engine12-x64-lab/record/recipe.json. Pin precedes signing; engine_abi.py does not normalize PE signatures.
